text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High IB packet loss detected in rack ibx-rack-7. Serving health checks failing on 4/12 replicas, observed container restarts and CUDA OOMs. Affected clusters: serving-prod-us-west-2-a. Paging on-call. thread:1719204321

eric: got the page, I'm on it. grabbing logs and will stand up a bridge.

maya: i'm seeing repeated 'NVML: GPU process terminated' in gpusrv-3 logs, stacks show OOM on allocations around 1.2GB per request.

rajesh: net-metrics spike: ibx-rack-7 tx_retransmit_rate jumped to 18% at 11:04:12 UTC, link flaps on mlx5_0. We also have packet reorders reported by ofed.

cameron: customer impact: a group of high-throughput inference customers (~5 tenants) reporting >50% error rate and latency 10-20s. degradation page created.

eric: triage plan: 1) isolate affected nodes, 2) route traffic away (enable fallback pool), 3) reduce batch sizes & disable pooling to reduce memory. 4) work with infra to check fabric.

infra-bot: runbook step triggered: "Isolate flaky IB NICs". Suggested commands:
```
# list pods on node
kubectl -n serving get pods -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-ibx-07
# cordon and drain
kubectl cordon gpu-ibx-07
kubectl drain gpu-ibx-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

maya: starting traffic shift to fallback - enabling routing policy 'serve-degrade-2026-03' (50% to fallback region, 50% to remaining capacity).

rajesh: also pushing temporary kernel RDMA tweak on nodes: increase rdev timeout and reduce QP retries. command I ran:
```
echo 200 > /sys/module/mlx5_core/parameters/log_num_mtt
# adjust rdma timeout
ethtool -K mlx5_0 rx on tx on
/sbin/sysctl -w net.core.netdev_max_backlog=5000
```

cameron: noted. we've also lowered default batch_size from 8 -> 2 and disabled KV cache for affected model endpoints. That should reduce peak GPU memory.

eric: log snippet from gpusrv-3 at 11:05:03:
```
[2026-03-12T11:05:03Z] ERROR serving.runtime: allocation failed: CUDA out of memory (free: 190MB, requested: 1024MB)
Stack: allocate_token_cache -> build_request_tensor -> cudaMalloc
Container restart triggered: exit code 137
```

maya: after traffic shift and batch reduction, error rate dropped from 60% -> 18%, latency back to 2-4s for routed traffic. Some pods still crash during high-concurrency bursts.

rajesh: infra observation: mlx5 firmware reported link flaps correlated with fabric congestion. We see IB port 3 on gpu-ibx-07 dropped 3 times in 6 minutes. Suggest fabric-level mitigation: disable ECMP on the top-of-rack for affected flows and increase reordering window on switches. Eng-sre, want help filing with DC ops?

sre-lead: I'm on the call with DC ops. We're requesting a microburst smoothing config and temporarily moving some routes. They agree to a conservative reroute for the rack while we stabilize.

infra-bot: note: set autoscaling to 20% buffer for fallback pool to absorb load.

eric: mitigation checklist update: - routing policy active (yes) - nodes cordoned (gpu-ibx-07, gpu-ibx-08) - batch size reduced (yes) - KV cache disabled (yes) - infra RDMA tweak applied (yes) - DC ops reroute in progress (in progress).

cameron: customer comms: Sent status update to impacted customers @11:18 UTC - we flagged degraded performance and mitigation steps. ETA for full restoration unknown.

maya: attempting graceful eviction of remaining gpusrv pods to force cold starts with smaller memory footprint. Doing a rolling restart of runtime pods with env var ML_MAX_BATCH=2.

rajesh: monitoring: packet loss decreased to 2.5% after reroute, retransmit rate back to baseline. No new CUDA OOMs observed in last 6m.

eric: good. leaving one oncall handoff note: if we see renewed GPU OOMs after reroute lifts, we'll need to revert batching and do deeper memory profiling (heap dumps).

cameron: marking incident SEV2 -> SEV3 per customer impact reduction. Updating ops board. :thumbsup:

sre-lead: post-incident actions: 1) postmortem owner: maya, 2) infra action: firmware/driver audit on mlx5 nodes, 3) runtime hardening: graceful degrade on packet loss threshold, 4) playbook: add automatic routing to fallback on sustained IB retransmits >10% for 3m.

incident-bot: Pager resolved for eric. Incident channel will remain open for postmortem notes.

eric: thanks team. leaving notes for postmortem: timeline, commands run, DC ops reroute ticket #DC-4421, customer-comm IDs sent. I'll kick off postmortem doc.

maya: adding a small debug log we collected from runtime showing repeated RDMA timeouts before OOM:
```
[2026-03-12T11:03:55Z] WARN rdma.transport: timeout waiting for response qp 0x3a4, retry=4
[2026-03-12T11:03:56Z] WARN rdma.transport: tx_retries exceeded on port 3
[2026-03-12T11:04:00Z] INFO serving.runtime: request_queue depth spike -> triggering aggressive prefetch -> increased GPU allocations
```

rajesh: adding to infra TODO: schedule switch-level capture for ibx-rack-7 during next maintenance window; also plan a driver rollback test to previous mlx5 release on a canary node.

cameron: noting customer impact summary for postmortem: 5 tenants, elevated error rates for ~22 minutes, degraded latency for ~35 minutes, no data loss.

eric: closing the active mitigation loop. Will post link to postmortem and timeline when ready. Great job triaging quickly. :clap:
